name: bondsmith
description: Surgebinders who wield Tension and Adhesion. Bondsmiths are rare and powerful Radiants who unify people, forge oaths, and embody the spirit of connection. They are the soul of the Knights Radiant, leaders, diplomats, and anchors of unity.
sprenDescription: Bondsmiths bond one of three unique godspren: the Stormfather, the Nightwatcher, or the Sibling. These are not companion spren but world-level entities.

ideals.label: first ideal
ideals.description: The universal Ideal shared by all Radiants. A pledge to value life, seek strength for the right reasons, and walk a path of purpose over outcome.
quotes: Life before death, strength before weakness, journey before destination.

ideals.label: second ideal
ideals.description: The Bondsmith begins to bind others, forging connection, not through command, but trust.
quotes: I will unite instead of divide.

ideals.label: third ideal
ideals.description: They swear to act as the bridge between factions, people, or ideas, even when standing in the middle is the hardest place to be.
quotes: I will take upon myself the responsibility of connection.
I will hold the center when all else breaks apart.

ideals.label: fourth ideal
ideals.description: The Bondsmith accepts the burden of unity, to mend broken trusts, to restore oaths, and to speak for the voiceless.
quotes: I will be the voice that echoes in silence, the bond that endures.

ideals.label: fifth ideal
ideals.description: They become the spiritual anchor of the Radiants, the heart of honor, uniting all others with unshakable purpose.
